title: I'm becoming AI-blind
summary: 作者反思自己作为开发者，在AI辅助编程工具普及后，逐渐失去对代码细节的敏感度和判断力，变得依赖AI生成代码而难以发现其潜在问题，并担忧这种‘AI盲化’对长期技能和软件质量的影响。
highlights: losing the ability to spot subtle bugs in AI-generated code
the more I rely on AI, the less I trust my own judgment
AI-generated code often looks correct but hides deep flaws
